latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of m5stack-chrome-browser-control skill.
- Enables remote control of the local Chrome browser via the MCP chrome-devtools protocol, supporting webpage navigation, Outlook email management, and content searching tasks.
- Requires users to enable Chrome remote debugging (127.0.0.1:9222) and configure OpenClaw MCP with chrome-devtools-mcp.
- Provides clear setup instructions, command reference, common task flows (e.g., reading Outlook mail, searching X/Twitter), and troubleshooting guidance.
- Supports browser tab management, page navigation, web automation actions (click, fill, wait), and snapshot/screenshot functionalities.
